scope: Relative reference complexity within this skill and its stated objectives; not an absolute human-difficulty score.

levels.label: Foundation
levels.criteria: Expose a core relation with limited prerequisite planning and accessible recovery.

levels.label: Combination
levels.criteria: Connect preparations, changing input access, or reuse of the same mechanism.

levels.label: Planning
levels.criteria: Coordinate deeper dependencies, constrained shared space, role changes, or recovery tradeoffs.

difficulty.rationale: Shared helper bays, changing pushing faces and repeated recovery prepare an offset final use; the revised endpoint also includes returning to the doorway. Structural planning estimate, not a playtest score.

Two interacting helper exchanges reserve circulation before axial delivery; target repositioning and tool withdrawal follow first contact. Comparable planning tier, without a strict rank against the other branches.
Roles change: the bar is parked, one L is restored and transported, and another L is reused before offset contact and whole-target support loss. Planning estimate with a complete return objective.
